I added a log line to `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py`. It runs after the amount check passes, so it only fires for refunds that go through:

```python
log.info("invoice_refunded", invoice_id=invoice.id)
```

It uses `structlog` with a module-level `log = structlog.get_logger()` and a snake_case event name, the same way `src/billing/invoices.py` does, following the project's logging rule. I haven't run anything to test it.

The line only records the invoice id, as you asked. If you also want the refunded amount, add `amount_cents=amount_cents` to the same call.
